title: Daily Source Pass
summary: Today's issue is built from Eastpoint, Tennessean/AOL, Metro East Bank, East Nashville venue listings, Nashville Public Library, Metro Parks, and a private-platform hold. The lead package is public-source only.

stages.name: Development Follow
stages.goal: Update Eastpoint after the May 28 formal groundbreaking.
stages.output: Found a post-groundbreaking report saying construction kicked off on Eastpoint Flats, and reattached the official May 30 kickoff listing.

stages.name: Friday Venue Scan
stages.goal: Build the East Nashville Friday night music lane.
stages.output: Confirmed The Basement East, Eastside Bowl, and The East Room listings for tonight from public venue and ticket pages.

stages.name: Weekend Family Scan
stages.goal: Find public family utility for Saturday.
stages.output: Confirmed East Branch Library's Saturday Summer Reading Challenge kickoff listings and Friday/Saturday hours.

stages.name: Metro Utility Scan
stages.goal: Add citywide public events only where useful.
stages.output: Pulled Nashville.gov's May 29 parks listings: Fort Negley tour, Full Moon Pickin' Party, and Moonlight Meander.

stages.name: Private Platform Gate
stages.goal: Keep Facebook and Nextdoor out without supervised capture.
stages.output: No new Facebook or Nextdoor material was promoted. Private-platform items stay held until visible supervised capture is available.

stages.name: Publish Pack
stages.goal: Ship source-backed web stories and newsletter-ready copy.
stages.output: Five May 29 stories are ready with source trails, labels, social cuts, and generated/fallback covers.
